# Tahoe Bio Plugins

> The Git-based plugin catalog for Tahoe Bio's public agent plugins. Its first
> plugin is Tara, which connects your own agent to Tahoe's public dataset
> service; the signed-in account's `list_releases` response determines access.
> Tahoe-100M routes are always available. Emerald Bay routes require server
> 0.4.0 or later and advertised Emerald capabilities. Validated pathway
> readouts require server 0.5.0 or later and the panel in discovery.

- README: https://github.com/tahoebio/tahoe-public-plugins/blob/main/README.md

## Install and update

Install from the `main` channel; do not pin a version tag if you want updates.

- Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add tahoebio/tahoe-public-plugins`,
  then `claude plugin install tara@tahoe-public`. Third-party marketplaces have
  auto-update **off by default**; enable it in `/plugin` → **Marketplaces** →
  **tahoe-public** → **Enable auto-update**. To update now, run
  `claude plugin update tara@tahoe-public`, or use **Update marketplace** in
  `/plugin` (the shell `claude plugin marketplace update` alone only refreshes
  listings).
- Codex CLI: `codex plugin marketplace add tahoebio/tahoe-public-plugins --ref main`,
  `codex plugin add tara@tahoe-public`, then `codex mcp login tahoe-public` and
  start a new session. For later versions run
  `codex plugin marketplace upgrade tahoe-public` and start a new session.

An organization administrator may centrally enable Claude auto-update with
managed `extraKnownMarketplaces["tahoe-public"]` (`autoUpdate: true`) and
`enabledPlugins["tara@tahoe-public"]: true`.

Verify the installed manifest shows `0.5.0`, then make a signed-in
`list_releases` call and an Emerald call with `dataset="emerald-bay"`.
